objective: Owner's go-ahead of 2026-11-23 for the six leads B309 to B314 recorded by the coordinator's review of four Codex threads and the studies of 20 to 23 November: the operator test as a reading of growth (B310), a learner whose examples are knots (B311), uniform present words with births as the settings (B309), sources that share one supply (B313), which recorded signals an ordinary process can send (B312) and the rule that is both parity and not-all-equal (B314). Each child freezes its own design, runs to its stop and reports; the synthesis compares them against G1, G15, G17 and G18.
stop_rule: Each child stops at its own frozen stop condition; the epic closes when all six have reported and the synthesis is written.
title: Six leads from the review of 23 November
